turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files:
  - b3_te_dopant_train.csv: 266 real samples, columns process/composition
    columns (Sb, Co, Fe) and `target` (the measured zT at 700 K among
    Skutterudite-based (doping/processing) variants).
  - b3_te_dopant_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE samples whose zT at 700 K among
    Skutterudite-based (doping/processing) variants was NOT measured,
    columns `candidate_id` and the same process/composition columns.

Using the training data, predict which candidates have the HIGHEST zT at 700
K among Skutterudite-based (doping/processing) variants, then select the 5
best candidates from the pool.

Reason from the training data, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
The training measurements exhibit large scatter (unlisted process factors) but several local composition neighborhoods are consistently elevated. Inverse-distance weighting of the nearest training points therefore supplies a robust ranking of the unmeasured pool.

- The isolated high-Co pocket (Sb \(\approx 0.587\), Co \(\approx 0.396\), Fe \(= 0\)) contains two independent measurements both \(> 1.25\). Candidate c023 lies inside this pocket and receives a predicted zT \(\approx 1.30\).
- A tight micro-cluster at Sb \(\approx 0.722\), Co \(\approx 0.242\), Fe \(= 0\) contains the two highest recorded values (1.37 and 1.29). Candidate c067 sits at the center of the two high points (predicted zT \(\approx 1.28\)).
- The broader high-performing island around Sb \(\approx 0.74\), Co \(\approx 0.241\), Fe \(= 0\) yields several measurements between 1.16 and 1.21. The two pool members that land nearest the upper end of this island are c065 (\(\approx 1.19\)) and c036 (\(\approx 1.18\)).
- A third, low-variance pocket (Sb \(\approx 0.729\), Co \(\approx 0.223\), Fe \(\approx 0.022\)) is uniformly \(1.11\)–\(1.15\). Candidate c001 is essentially coincident with those three points (predicted zT \(\approx 1.14\)).

All other pool members either lie closer to mediocre/low training points or sit in regions of still higher scatter, producing lower expected zT. The resulting ranking is therefore

Final: c023, c067, c065, c036, c001
